title: EnumDescriptor
description: Describes an integer-backed enum definition for use in entity properties and select/kanban UI, including optional per-value display metadata.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: define enums before entity properties that reference them. Use a stable namespace-style `name` such as `Acme.Events.EventStatus`. Each value name should be PascalCase and unique within the enum. Use explicit integer `value`s for stable persistence; do not reorder or renumber after data exists. Add `displayName`, `presentation`, `color`, and `icon` on values when pages should render badges or icons by default; pages can still override them with `enumPresentations`.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Stable unique enum name. Use a namespace-style name if the enum belongs to a module/domain, for example 'Acme.Events.EventStatus'.

app.description: Name of the low-code app that owns this enum. Omit for the default app. Must match an apps[].name.

displayName.description: User-facing enum title used by the designer, for example 'Event Status'.

order.description: Optional sort order used when listing enums in the designer. Lower values appear first.

extendsLowerLayer.description: When true, this descriptor extends an enum with the same name defined in a lower model layer (for example a code enum) by adding values or display metadata instead of defining a new enum.

values.description: Ordered list of integer-backed enum values. Values are stored as integers; names are used for display and model readability. The array is always required; it may be empty only when extendsLowerLayer is true and the descriptor changes just displayName/order/metadata.

name.description: PascalCase enum value name, for example 'Draft', 'Scheduled', or 'Completed'.

value.description: Stable integer value. Prefer explicit values starting at 0 so generated descriptor JSON is deterministic. When omitted, the previous value plus one is assigned.

displayName.description: User-facing label for this value, for example 'In Progress'. Defaults to the value name.

presentation.description: Default runtime presentation for this value: text, badge, or iconOnly.

color.description: Default badge color for this value, for example '#F59E0B'.

icon.description: Default icon for this value, used by badge and iconOnly presentations.
